centreAddress: Highline Building, Baker's Point, Pottery Rd, Kill Of The Grange, Dún Laoghaire, A96 KW29
paragraphs: From Dun Laoghaire Driving Test Centre on Clonkeen Crescent, pull off and take the 1st left to stay on Clonkeen Crescent.
At the end of the road, turn right onto Pottery Road and follow it for just over 1 km.
At the end of Pottery Road, turn left onto Johnstown Road.
At the next end of road, turn right onto Rochestown Avenue.
At the roundabout, take the exit left onto Avondale Road.
Turn right onto Ballinclea Road and work through the estate with a series of right turns on Ballinclea Road.
Turn left onto Violet Hill for a short stretch.
At the end of the road, turn right to rejoin Ballinclea Road and follow it for nearly 900 metres.
Turn left onto Killiney Road and pull in briefly to practice.
Move off and continue on Killiney Road, then turn left into Avondale Park.
At the roundabout, turn left back onto Avondale Road.
Take the 1st right into Arnold Grove for a quiet residential section.
Leaving Arnold Grove, turn right onto Hillcourt Road and pull in briefly to practice.
Move off on Hillcourt Road, then turn left onto Bellevue Road.
Turn left again onto Glenageary Road Upper.
Take the next right onto Adelaide Road.
Turn left into Silchester Park, keeping slightly right as the road bends.
After a short stop, continue left through Silchester Park and turn left onto Glenageary Road Lower.
At the roundabout, take the exit left onto Sally Glen Road and stay slightly left on Sally Glen Road for around 1.4 km.
Pull in briefly, then move off and at the roundabout take the exit for Rochestown Avenue, staying left.
Turn left into Granitefield, and after a short stop continue right through Granitefield.
Turn left onto Johnstown Road.
Turn right onto Pottery Road and follow it back for over 1 km.
Turn left to remain on Pottery Road, then take the right into Clonkeen Crescent.
At the end of the road turn right, then left to complete the loop on Clonkeen Crescent.
Turn left onto Pottery Road and then right again on Pottery Road.
At the end of the road, turn right onto Rochestown Avenue and return toward Dun Laoghaire Driving Test Centre.
